Aircraft Skin Processing.problem_summary: Flexible job shop scheduling for aircraft skin components. Each job consists of ordered operations, each assignable to candidate machines with given processing times. Minimize makespan.

decision_variables.name: x[j][o]
decision_variables.description: Master interval variable for operation o of job j.

decision_variables.name: x[j][o][m]
decision_variables.description: Optional interval variable for operation o of job j on machine m.

constraints.description: Each operation is executed on exactly one machine.
Operations within a job execute in sequence.
Each machine executes at most one operation at a time.
Tight constraint: gap between consecutive ops <= 15.
Loose constraint: gap between consecutive ops >= 30.

Battery Pack Design.problem_summary: Select which battery modules to activate each period to satisfy load current and voltage constraints while minimizing total energy loss (C+R cost).

decision_variables.name: s[k][i][j]
decision_variables.description: 1 if module (i,j) active in period k.

decision_variables.name: p[k]
decision_variables.description: Number of active modules per column in period k.

parameters.name: CELL_NOMINAL_VOLTAGE
parameters.description: Nominal voltage per cell used to derive voltage bounds.

constraints.description: Active modules per column equal p[k].
Total active module voltage must be at least 95% of nominal voltage times p[k].
Total active module voltage must be at most 105% of nominal voltage times p[k].
Load current satisfied by modules.

objective.description: Minimize total net energy loss (capacity + resistance cost).

Charging Station Location.problem_summary: Assign demand areas to charging stations and select which stations to open, minimizing total fixed + service cost subject to capacity constraints.

decision_variables.name: assignment[c]
decision_variables.description: Station assigned to demand area c.

decision_variables.name: load[p]
decision_variables.description: Total demand assigned to station p.

parameters.name: cost[c][p]
parameters.description: Service cost: demand area c to station p.

parameters.name: fixedCost[p]
parameters.description: Fixed opening cost of station p.

constraints.description: Station open iff its load > 0.
Aggregate demand by assignment.

DNA Sequence Design.problem_summary: Design 6 DNA sequences of length 8 satisfying GC-content, pairwise Hamming distance, and reverse-complement distance constraints. Feasibility problem.

decision_variables.name: words[i][j]
decision_variables.description: Nucleotide at position j of sequence i (0=A,1=T,2=C,3=G).

constraints.description: Each sequence must come from the valid word list.
Exactly 4 G/C bases per sequence (50% GC content).
Pairwise Hamming distance >= 4 between any two sequences.
Hamming distance >= 4 to reverse complement of any sequence.

objective.description: Find any assignment satisfying all constraints.

VRP.problem_summary: Route a fleet of vehicles from a depot to serve all customers, respecting capacity constraints, minimizing total Euclidean travel distance.

decision_variables.name: arc[v][i][j]
decision_variables.description: 1 if vehicle v travels arc i→j.

decision_variables.name: u[v][i]
decision_variables.description: Visit position of node i for vehicle v (subtour elimination).

constraints.description: Each customer visited exactly once.
Flow in equals flow out at each customer.
Each vehicle leaves/returns depot at most once.
Vehicle capacity not exceeded.
Miller-Tucker-Zemlin subtour elimination.
